{{Otheruses|Algarian}}
The '''Algarian Bureau of Planetary Colonization''' was one of the many Bureaus that made up the [[Algarian Bureaucracy]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], it was involved in a dispute with the [[Bureau of Volcanoes]] over jurisdictional rights to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tonder]].
